one_liner: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) is a broad Graph API REST surface with webhooks. Direct use is self-serve with system-user tokens. Serving other businesses needs Tech Provider status, App Review with Advanced access and Embedded Signup. Meta publishes an official beta WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server.
auth_notes: Graph API calls use Bearer access tokens. Direct developers generate a system user access token in Business Settings, which is a static secret (API_KEY). Partners use business tokens, and Embedded Signup authorizes the partner's app to access client assets. The MCP server uses OAuth sign-in. The pages do not detail the Graph OAuth flow, so OAUTH2 as primary is medium confidence.
access_notes: Apps not used by other businesses follow the Cloud API Get Started guide, so single-business use is self-serve. Accessing WABAs the app's business does not own requires Advanced access via App Review. Pricing details are not settled by the supplied pages.
blocker_notes: Serving other businesses requires App Review with Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging, plus Embedded Signup onboarding. Tech Provider clients must supply their own payment method. The official MCP is beta, aimed at development and testing, not production sending at scale.
